description:
An open-source editor for Line 6 HX pedals and the StompStation PRO

TonePush is an open-source editor for Line 6 HX-family devices and the Sonulab StompStation PRO, with a cross-platform GUI and a scriptable command-line tool (tonepush). Edit the signal chain, presets, snapshots, setlists, footswitches and device settings, back up the whole pedal with a history, and upload impulse responses.
It needs a graphics driver with OpenGL 2.0 or newer.
TonePush 0.9.1 moves the Windows installer to a per-user Windows Installer package, waits for TonePush to quit before uninstalling, and uses less memory for fallback fonts.
